$schema_note: Per-known-format column layout, read by structure_map.build_known_map. A T12 always has 12 monthly columns + (usually) a trailing total, and within one detected format those value_columns are constant (verified across the sample corpus) — so we CONFIGURE them here instead of detecting the span (which was letting stray cells, e.g. Mirador's 5-cent column O, sneak in). month_header_row / data_start_row genuinely vary file-to-file within a format, so they are 'dynamic' (detected). A future format with fixed header rows can put a literal list there, e.g. [9, 10].
